pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, stellate dark regions characterized by multi-pointed angular protrusions. Edges exhibit high-contrast, sharp pixel gradients against the lighter corridors. Spatial area of patches is heterogeneous, showing relative reduction in size toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned negative space forming a complex topological graph. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radiate and quadri-radiate intersections. Corridor thickness is non-uniform, with visible pixel-width fluctuations at bottleneck points between patch vertices.
